name: freshness-fast-path
body: The win-A reuse path: `apg scan` reuses the existing `db.lbug` when the current tree's content identity equals the scan recorded in `graph.jsonl` line 1, skipping the rebuild. Reuse is what lets a diverged-but-re-anchored DB persist, because the recorded line sits ahead of the DB's own `Scan` row and the next scan takes the reuse path instead of the rebuild that corrects the divergence.
